newsitem.title: CANADA: PacFor, Avenor to seek buyers.
newsitem.headline: PacFor, Avenor to seek buyers.

text.p: Pacific Forest Products Ltd and Avenor Inc said on Thursday they have agreed to undertake a search for potential buyers of all of Pacific's common shares.
The companies said in a statement that they are also considering creating a timberland income fund to maximize shareholder value.
Avenor currently owns approximately 53 percent of Pacific's outstanding common shares. The remaining shares are held by independent investors, the statement said.

The agreement follows Avenor's announcement on January 28 that it intends to focus on core businesses and proceed with the divestiture of its assets in British Columbia in connection with the proposed acquisition of Repap Enterprises Inc.
A special committee of Pacific's board -- made up of two Avenor representatives and two independent members of the board -- has been formed to oversee the process.
The board has retained RBC Dominion Securities Inc as financial advisors in connection with the transaction, the statement said.
British Columbia-based Pacific Forest owns and operates three sawmills on Vancouver Island with an annual capacity of 700,000 cubic metres of lumber and 500,000 cubic metres of woodchips.

Located in coastal British Columbia, Pacific's forest resources include 125,000 hectares of privately-owned timberlands and Crown timber tenures which provide an aggregate annual harvest of 2.5 million cubic metres.
